en.t: In a flash, it was already April.

units.source_text: 有一天傍晚，薰大将想起：浮舟如果不死，今日应是乔迁入京之日，便觉悲伤更甚。

en.t: One evening, General Kaoru remembered that if Ukifune had not died, this would have been the day she moved to the capital, and his grief deepened all the more.

units.source_text: 庭前近处的花橘发出可爱的香气。

en.t: The orange blossoms near the front of the garden gave off a lovely fragrance.
A cuckoo flew past and called twice.

units.source_text: 薰大将独吟“杜宇若能通冥府”之诗，犹觉未能慰情。

en.t: General Kaoru recited alone a poem about whether the cuckoo could reach the realm of the dead, yet still felt no comfort in his heart.

units.source_text: 这一天匂亲王正好来到北院，薰大将便命人折取花橘一枝，赋诗系在枝上送去。

en.t: That day Prince Niou happened to come to the northern residence, so General Kaoru had someone break off a sprig of orange blossoms, attached a poem to it, and sent it to him.
